https://www.wrganews.com/2026/07/31/form.text: Sign In Search Home NEWS Local News Bartow County Bill Crane’s Weekly Column Chattooga County Cherokee County, Alabama Community Calendar Floyd County Gordon County Paulding County Polk County Videos ON AIR First News with Doug Walker Weekday Schedule Weekend Schedule CONTACT US Contests Employment Opportunities General Contest & Sweepstakes Rules Public File ADVERTISE +RADIO 103.1 Radio M 104.9 The Rebel My K Country Q102 South 93.5 Former Latvian ‘Dancing with the Stars’ contestant arrested by ICE after violent criminal history revealed Jul 31, 2026 | 7:29 PM U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has arrested a former contestant on Latvia’s version of “Dancing with the Stars” who authorities say overstayed his visa and has a criminal history that includes aggravated assault with a gun, sexual battery and drug-related offenses. ICE announced Friday that agents arrested Roberts Nemiro, a Latvian national, in San Francisco on Tuesday after a referral from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. According to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Nemiro is in removal proceedings after remaining in the United States beyond the expiration of his visa. Nemiro appeared on “Dejo ar zvaigzni!,” the Latvian adaptation of the British television series “Strictly Come Dancing,” better known in the U.S. as “Dancing with the Stars.” ICE ARRESTS 15 ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS WITH CONVICTIONS INCLUDING HOMICIDE, RAPE AND CHILD SEX CRIMES OVER WEEKEND According to DHS, Nemiro entered the United States on a visa in October 2011 but remained in the country after it expired in August 2012. The agency said his criminal history includes convictions for aggravated assault of a non-family member with a gun and disorderly conduct. DHS also said he has been arrested on charges of battery, sexual battery, possession of a controlled substance and possession of drug paraphernalia. “This illegal alien from Latvia may have once had a career as a professional dancer on TV, but has turned into a career criminal with a rap sheet that includes aggravated assault with a gun, sexual battery, and drug possession,” DHS Assistant Secretary Lauren Bis said in a statement. WATCH: DEM DEMANDS ‘ONE CASE’ WHERE SANCTUARY CITIES DIDN’T TURN OVER ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS; DHS PROVIDES LIST “Despite California being a sanctuary state , ICE was able to arrest this criminal and get him off our streets, and he will soon be deported from our country. ICE is bringing the curtain down on his illegal stay and crime spree here in the U.S.,” Bis added. The arrest comes as the Trump administration continues to highlight immigration enforcement efforts involving noncitizens accused or convicted of violent crimes while criticizing California’s sanctuary policies . In Friday’s release, DHS cited several recent cases involving illegal immigrants arrested or sought by ICE in California and argued that the state’s sanctuary policies have hindered federal immigration enforcement. A representative for ICE did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital’s request for additional information. WEATHER Thu Aug 13 Rome, GA, USA 86°F Sunny

https://telex.hu/transtelex/2026/09/01/m.text: Menü Kereső Kiszáradt a Maros összes mellékfolyója Arad megyében, a folyó vízhozama a szokásos harmadára esett Transtelex Tőkés Hunor (Transtelex) Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom Kiszáradt a Maros összes mellékfolyója Arad megyében az elmúlt hónapok csapadékhiánya miatt, maga a folyó pedig a megyei szakaszán átlagosan már csak az ilyenkor megszokott vízmennyiség körülbelül harmadát szállítja. A négy fő Arad megyei mérőpont mindegyikén jóval a sokéves átlag alatt van a Maros vízhozama. Soborsinnál másodpercenként 63,8 köbmétert mértek, ami nagyjából a fele az ilyenkor megszokottnak. Lippánál már csak a sokéves átlag 26 százalékát, Aradnál 29 százalékát, a magyar határ közelében fekvő romániai Nagylaknál pedig 32 százalékát szállította a folyó. Utóbbi mérőpontnál másodpercenként 42,8 köbméteres vízhozamot mértek. A Maros innen Magyarország felé tart, majd Apátfalva és Makó térségén halad keresztül, végül Szegednél ömlik a Tiszába. A magyar vízügy adatai szerint szeptember 1-jén 0 órakor Makónál mínusz 117 centiméteres vízállást és másodpercenként 36,9 köbméteres vízhozamot mértek. A mínusz 117 centiméter önmagában is beszédes adat: 2022-ben még ez számított a valaha mért legalacsonyabb makói vízállásnak. Ezt 2025-ben több új negatív rekord is megdöntötte, október elején mínusz 124 centiméterig süllyedt a folyó. A Telexnek akkor nyilatkozó kutató szerint a Maros vízszintje 2012 óta tartósan csökken, és a vízhozama is egyre kisebb. A román vízügyi szakemberek szerint Arad megyében nagyon nagy a baj, mert nincs utánpótlás, ugyanis a Maros valamennyi mellékfolyója kiszáradt. A folyó ugyanakkor még nincs történelmi mélyponton: a régióban mért legalacsonyabb vízhozamot 1985 januárjában jegyezték fel, akkor másodpercenként alig 15,5 köbméter vizet szállított. A hónapok óta tartó szárazság a mezőgazdaságban is komoly károkat okozott. Mintegy 1300 Arad megyei gazda jelentett károkat az őszi vetésekben, elsősorban a búzában. Összesen 79 359 hektárnyi terület érintett, ahol a felmérések szerint 30–70 százalék közötti a kár. Augusztus végén már írtunk arról, hogy a magyar–román határ mindkét oldalán látványosan kiégtek a földek . Akkor csak a tavaszi vetésekre 995 kárbejelentés érkezett Arad megyében, több mint 23 ezer hektárról, egyes kukorica- és napraforgótáblákon pedig 90 százalék fölötti, helyenként csaknem teljes terméskárról számoltak be. A határ magyar oldalán sem volt sokkal jobb a helyzet: az Alföldön augusztus végére a kukorica és a napraforgó jelentős része elszáradt. A rendkívüli szárazság és a vízkészletek apadása miatt többszintű korlátozás is érvényben van. A megnövekedett fogyasztás és a tározók lassú utántöltődése miatt az Aradi Vízügyi Vállalat különböző korlátozásokat léptetett életbe: 16 Arad megyei településen éjszakai vízkorlátozás van, minden éjszaka elzárják a vizet éjfél és hajnali négy óra között, hogy a tározók nyomása és tartaléka napközbenre helyreálljon. Vannak olyan kritikus fekvésű települések a megyében, például Kiszend , ahol a felszíni patakok teljes elapadása miatt a lakosok naponta mindössze 2 órán át kapnak vizet a hálózatból. A helyi hatóságok szigorúan szabályozzák a felszíni vizek kivételét is. A kritikus vízhozam miatt a Maros menti gazdáknak korlátozták vagy megtiltották a folyóvíz közvetlen használatát öntözési célokra, megvédve a minimális ökológiai vízmennyiséget. https://www.baltictimes.com/freeport_of_.text: Estonia Latvia Lithuania Business Analysis Opinions Culture EU Affairs Search Archive Freeport of Riga receives record-high number of cruise ship passengers this season 2026-09-28 LETA/TBT Staff Photo: wasi1370 from Pixabay RIGA - The Freeport of Riga has welcomed 150,000 cruise ship passengers so far this season, setting a new record, the Freeport of Riga Authority informed LETA. The freeport notes that with the visits of the cruise ships Hamburg, MSC Magnifica and AIDAmar last weekend, the port has broken the previous record for the number of cruise passengers handled in a single season. Since May, 150,000 tourists have arrived in Riga on cruise ships, and the 2026 cruise season will continue until the end of December. Most cruise passengers arriving in Riga came from Germany, the US, and the UK. According to forecasts, the total number of cruise passengers this year will be approximately 30 percent higher than last year. The freeport notes that the increase in passenger numbers confirms that Riga continues to strengthen its position in the international cruise market. This has been facilitated by several years of targeted efforts by the Freeport of Riga Authority and the city’s partners, who have jointly promoted Riga in the international cruise market and established cooperation with cruise lines. To attract cruise ships, the Freeport of Riga Authority works in collaboration with the Riga Investment and Tourism Agency (LiveRiga), the Riga Passenger Port, Riga RoPax Terminal, and other companies in the tourism sector. The freeport notes that this year’s cruise season at the Freeport of Riga is proceeding successfully. It began on May 3 with a visit by the German cruise ship Hamburg, with a total of 98 cruise ships scheduled to call at the port by the end of the year. Six ships visited Riga for the first time this season, while 13 cruise ships stayed in Riga for two days. One of the most significant events of this season was the arrival of the largest cruise ship ever handled at the Freeport of Riga. On May 22, the Mein Schiff Relax, a 333-meter-long and 42-meter-wide cruise ship operated by the German cruise line TUI Cruises, entered the port for the first time. This cruise ship is scheduled to call at the Freeport of Riga a total of five times this season. This cruise season, the Freeport of Riga has also seen several calls by large premium-class ships and vessels in the expedition or niche cruise segment. Among them were several newly built, next-generation cruise vessels, including the Scenic Eclipse II, Seven Seas Grandeur, and Explora III, which called at the Freeport of Riga in August. The freeport notes that the increase in the number of ships and passengers in this segment in Riga is considered a significant achievement, as attracting luxury and expedition cruise ships is one of the cruise tourism segments purposefully developed by the Freeport of Riga Authority and its partners. The cruise season at the port will continue through the fall and winter. Two visits by the large cruise ships, the Norwegian Sun and the Mein Schiff Relax, are planned for October, while the luxury expedition ship Le Commandant Charcot will arrive Riga in November. Four more cruise ship calls have been scheduled for December. The 2026 cruise season will conclude on December 26, when the AIDAprima will depart Riga following a two-day Christmas visit. LETA previously reported that the number of cruise ship passengers served at the Freeport of Riga in the first eight months of this year grew by 54.9 percent compared to the same period in 2025. In the first eight months of 2026, the Freeport of Riga handled a total of 115,356 cruise ship passengers, while during the corresponding period in 2025, the port served 74,493 cruise passengers. In 2025, the Freeport of Riga received a total of 115,469 cruise ship passengers, which is 42.8 percent more than in 2024, when the port served 80,870 cruise ship passengers. Photograph: Bianca de Marchi/AAP View image in fullscreen Coogee and Maroubra beaches have been closed after a whale carcass washed up on the rocks of a bay between them. Photograph: Bianca de Marchi/AAP Sydney ‘Almost looks fake’: two Sydney beaches closed after whale carcass washes up Swimming banned at Maroubra and Coogee while council prioritises ‘culturally respectful’ removal of remains Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Kat Wong Wed 21 Oct 2026 21.31 EDT Last modified on Wed 21 Oct 2026 22.34 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Coogee and Maroubra beaches have been closed as a precaution after a whale carcass washed up on the rocks between the two busy swimming and surfing spots in Sydney ’s eastern suburbs. The local council said it was working with rangers and the New South Wales Department of Primary Industries on the whale’s removal from a “difficult-to-access location surrounded by cliffs and rock ledge”. “As a precaution, Maroubra and Coogee Beach will remain closed until further notice while lifeguards monitor the situation and work with local stakeholders and authorities to arrange the whale’s removal,” Randwick council said. The council said it was considering closing the surrounding area and rock shelf walkway to manage crowds on the popular coastal walk. View image in fullscreen The council is encouraging residents and visitors to avoid the area and follow directions from lifeguards. Composite: Randwick City Council “At this stage, the carcass is not being removed and discussions are ongoing with the Gamay Rangers about a culturally and environmentally sensitive approach to take.” The mayor, Dr Clare Willington, said the council would ensure that the removal was “culturally respectful” to Indigenous Australians . “The whale is an important totem animal to the local Bidjigal people,” she said. “This is a natural occurrence and in time nature will deal with the carcass. Our focus is to manage and limit any impact to swimmers and surfers at nearby beaches.” The council is encouraging residents and visitors to avoid the area and follow directions from lifeguards and authorities. It comes as authorities are working to free a large whale found stuck in shallow waters off off Turners Beach on Tasmania’s north-west coast. “Members of the public are asked to avoid the area and not enter the water on the incoming tide due to the anticipated danger,” Tasmanian police said. Sign up for the Breaking News Australia email ‘Almost looks fake’ Curious locals have stopped by Lurline Bay throughout the morning to try catch a glimpse of the whale. skip past newsletter promotion Free newsletter | When needed Sign up to Breaking News Australia Get the most important news as it breaks after newsletter promotion Meeri Pajala, an au pair from Finland who is living in Sydney , said she had never seen anything like this before. “It almost looks fake to me,” she told Guardian Australia. “That skin looks so weird.” Glenda, a local who did not want her full name published, says she usually watches whales swimming by the coast and was curious when she heard the news. “My interest is in if it’s newborn, or if it’s juvenile,” she said. “I thought it would be more complete.” The carcass is relatively small and significantly deteriorated, with what appear to be bite marks along the blubber. It was nudging up against the rocks as the waves ebbed and flowed but has become stuck in a crevice due to low tide. To the surprise of many onlookers, it doesn’t seem to have a smell. Authorities are still determining what species it is, and how the carcass arrived in the bay but it is believed to have died some time ago.
